nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO converts VIN_5V to VCC_3V3 for the 3.3V system domain. VIN pin accepts external 5V, VOUT provides regulated 3.3V. GND is system common. This module is the sole VCC_3V3 provider; all 3.3V consumers connect here. Input and output need bypass capacitors per LDO stability requirements.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: GD32F103 ARM Cortex-M3 MCU. UART interface (TX/RX) connects to RS485 transceiver for Modbus communication. SPI interface (MOSI/MISO/SCK/CS) connects to external Flash for communication logging. BOOT0 configured for Flash boot mode (pulled low). HSE crystal required for clocking. NRST needs pull-up and decoupling. All digital IO operates at 3.3V level.

nodes.name: rs485_transceiver
nodes.description: SP3485 3.3V RS485 transceiver converts UART to differential RS485 signaling. DI receives MCU TX data, RO drives MCU RX data. DE and RE are driven by MCU for transmit/receive direction control (typically tied together or separately controlled for half-duplex operation). A and B are differential bus lines; termination resistor may be needed across A-B. VCC operates at 3.3V level matching MCU IO.

nodes.name: A
nodes.description: Non-inverting driver output / receiver input, RS-485 bus line

nodes.name: B
nodes.description: Inverting driver output / receiver input, RS-485 bus line

nodes.name: flash_storage
nodes.description: W25Q128JV 128Mbit SPI NOR Flash for communication logging. Standard SPI interface: CS for chip select (active low), DI for MOSI data input, DO for MISO data output, CLK for clock. WP and HOLD tied to VCC for normal operation (write protect disabled, hold disabled). SPI mode 0/3 compatible. Flash stores Modbus communication logs written by MCU.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect, active low (IO2 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.

nodes.name: HOLD
nodes.description: Hold/Reset, active low (IO3 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.
